successors.name: Great Seljuk Empire
successors.text: Erbil and Hakkari lands of the Hadhabanis

ledger.x: 906: Muhammad ibn Bilal al-Hadhbani raids the Mosul countryside; after a peace he gives up northern Mosul lands to the Daseni and Humaydi tribes, keeping Erbil and Shahrazur.
1080: the last listed mir, Abu Hija II Husain (1063 to 1080), ends; the page gives no successor, so the Seljuk takeover is a bridge.
1080: end of the page's list of Hadhabani mirs.

certainty.note: The page calls the Hadhabani a tribal confederation and gives no capital, limits or end date; its Arabic bibliography title reads 905 to 1258.
